svg.title: CopilotKit: Connect any agent to any user
svg.desc: The agentic product stack. CopilotKit connects user surfaces such as React, Angular, Vue, React Native, Slack and Teams to agent frameworks such as LangGraph, CrewAI, Mastra, Google ADK, PydanticAI and the Claude Agent SDK over AG-UI.
